data.name: GameFolderMissing
data.comment: Notice, after the player chose a game folder in settings ("Choose game folder…") that doesn't exist, or no longer does.

data.name: GameFolderNotTheGame
data.value: That folder doesn't hold Escape from Tarkov: there's no EscapeFromTarkov.exe and no Logs folder with game sessions in it or in its "build" folder. Choose the folder the game is installed in.
data.comment: Notice, after the player chose a game folder in settings that isn't the game's. EscapeFromTarkov.exe, Logs and "build" are the names of the game's file and folders: keep them as they are.

data.name: ScreenshotKeyPrintScreen
data.comment: The game's screenshot key, as help, the tour and the status bar name it ("press PrtSc"). Write it as this language's keyboards label the key (German: Druck for PrtSc, Strg for Ctrl). The Print Screen key.
